kind.description: Fixed protocol identifier for one operator-owned disposable qualification scope.

engine.description: Exact initial loopback SQL profile; never inferred from the host.

database.description: Fresh operator-created empty disposable database, one per selected case. Never a production database.

username.description: Exact isolated connection principal, checked against actual server identity. No password belongs here.

connection_sha256.description: SHA256 of the exact protected MySQL configuration JSON or PostgreSQL DSN file; bind before execution and do not modify during a case.

disposable.description: Required explicit operator acknowledgement of a disposable synthetic test scope. False never authorizes execution.
